_comment: Bundle budgets checked by scripts/bundle-report.mjs (GMR-53). PROPOSED defaults, not canon. Raise only with evidence and a canon update. Sizes in kilobytes (1 KB = 1024 B). GMR-99 (slim Phaser build) measured 204.3 KB initial JS gzip and 816.8 KB total; the budgets are those plus ~15% headroom.
_totalNote: totalKB counts everything in dist/ except *.map files (raw bytes).
